invariants.rationale: element is accessed throughout the method (e.g., element.getString()), so it must be non-null.
map is passed to loadLayer and likely used; it must be non-null for processing.
parentLayers.add(groupLayer) is called if the group is processed, implying parentLayers is non-null.
tmjFile is passed through for file/resource loading in recursive calls.
If the element is a group, at least one layer (the group) is added to parentLayers by the end of the method.
